adjudication.rationale: In `app/models/topic_embed.rb` the model method `self.import` appends an HTML footer directly into the imported body (`contents << "\n<hr>\n<small>...<a href='#{url}'>...`) and uses `I18n.t('embed.imported_from', link: ...)` to generate presentation markup. It also mutates the `contents` argument in-place via `<<`. This is a concrete separation-of-concerns / coupling issue introduced by the diff (model doing view-level HTML composition and side-effecting input), even if it may work functionally.
